title: The affine chart limit over the upper tail
statement: Under the scheme and base-change conventions of def-pc-scheme and def-pc-base-change, let R be a ring diagram on a directed preorder and c its affine limiting spectrum cone. Fix i, Xi -> Spec(R_i), an open cover V of Xi and an affine chart V.X a. There exist a scheme diagram D on the opposite of the upper tail above i and a limiting cone d whose objects are affine. Its vertex is isomorphic to the fixed limit chart Z. Each D_j is isomorphic to the corresponding stage chart U.X a; the iterated chart Y is isomorphic to Z. The latter isomorphism commutes with the chart maps to the ambient limit base change, and followed by the inverse vertex comparison, the limit projection and the stage comparison it is exactly U.pullbackHom p a.

source.place: Stacks Tags 01ZR and 01I6, affine reduction and pullback pasting

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed upperTailChartDiagram R i (V.f a followed by f) and upperTailChartCone. upperTailChartCone_isLimit proves the cone limiting. Every object is affine by the Mathlib affine pullback instance: Spec(R_j) -> Spec(R_i) is a morphism between affine schemes, and V.X a is affine. Apply the comparison theorem for this very cone to obtain z, e, h and the equations, and assemble the existential conclusion.

theorem exists_affine_chart_upper_tail_limit
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (V : Xi.OpenCover.{u}) (a : V.I₀) (ha : IsAffine (V.X a)) :
    let W := V.pullback₁ (pullback.fst f (c.π.app (op i)))
    let Z := W.X a
    ∃ (D : ({j : I // i ≤ j})ᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (d : Cone D),
      Nonempty (IsLimit d) ∧ (∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j)) ∧
      ∃ z : d.pt ≅ Z, ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
        let U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property)))).OpenCover.{u} :=
          V.pullback₁ (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))
        let p := baseChangeMap f
          (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))
          (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
          (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j.val)) (c.w (homOfLE j.property).op))
        let Y := (U.pullback₁ p).X a
        ∃ (e : D.obj (op j) ≅ U.X a) (h : Y ≅ Z),
          h.hom ≫ W.f a = (U.pullback₁ p).f a ∧
          h.hom ≫ z.inv ≫ d.π.app (op j) ≫ e.hom = U.pullbackHom p a
